about.intro: Mid-level Front-End Developer specialized in scalable interfaces, performance, testing, and accessibility.
paragraphs: Mid-level Front-End Developer with over 4 years of consolidated experience at RD Saúde, specialized in the React, Next.js, and TypeScript ecosystem.
I work on scalable interface architecture and Design Systems, with a proven record of reducing development time by 30% through reusable components and module standardization.

I bring a strong software quality mindset, increasing automated test coverage to 100% with Jest and React Testing Library while improving performance with Vite, Webpack, Redux, and code splitting strategies.
I work with advanced technical English (C1), WAI-ARIA digital accessibility, and close collaboration with UX/UI and product teams to deliver consistent and inclusive experiences.

highlights: Restructured front-end components and helped create a reusable React library, reducing new screen development time by up to 30%.
Increased automated test coverage from 50% to 100% with Jest and React Testing Library, improving release reliability.
Implemented WAI-ARIA accessibility patterns and usability practices to improve the navigation experience.
Optimized Front-End/Back-End communication with RESTful patterns, reducing real-time data loading latency.
Managed global state with Redux and Context API, reducing production data-flow bugs by 20%.
Configured Vite and Webpack with code splitting, reducing the final bundle size by 15% and improving initial loading.
